motions.item_title: Committee of the Whole Consent Report
motions.text: That the March 28, 2023, Committee of the Whole Consent Agenda be adopted:
motions.text_html: That the March 28, 2023, Committee of the Whole Consent Agenda be adopted:

motions.item_title: Implementation Strategy Report: South End Community Centre, 2023-64
motions.text: That the construction of the South End Community Centre be approved for a project cost of $115.5 million, with the project scope as approved under the October 7, 2020 report. That additional budget of $35.5 million be approved for project RF0092 South End Community Centre Construction, funded $33,725,000 from Parks and Recreation Development Charge Reserve Fund (#319) and $1,775,000 from tax supported debt funded from the Infrastructure Renewal Reserve Fund (#150).
motions.text_html:
1. That the construction of the South End Community Centre be approved for a project cost of $115.5 million, with the project scope as approved under the October 7, 2020 report.
  2. That additional budget of $35.5 million be approved for project RF0092 South End Community Centre Construction, funded $33,725,000 from Parks and Recreation Development Charge Reserve Fund (#319) and $1,775,000 from tax supported debt funded from the Infrastructure Renewal Reserve Fund (#150).

motions.text: That staff be directed to create a new schedule under the City’s Business Licensing By-law (2009)-18855 to regulate the licensing of short-term rental accommodations that incorporates the recommendations contained within this report.
